:::{#exr-euclidean-norm-practice}
#### Finding the norm of a vector with four entries

The [Euclidean norm](#def-euclidean-norm) works the same way in $\reals^4$ as in the plane,
although there is no picture to draw.
Let $\vx$ be the vector

$$
\vx = \sbmat{1 \\ 2 \\ 2 \\ 4}.
$$

Find $\norm{\vx}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Use @def-euclidean-norm with $p = 4$,
as in @exm-euclidean-norm.

:::
